source_title: i2kiselev/fm4-static-recomp: Forza Motorsport 4 recompilation based on ShiftGlue - GitHub
source_excerpt:
An unofficial static recompilation of the Xbox 360 release of Forza Motorsport 4 for Windows, built on your own PC from your own disc.
The game's PowerPC code is translated ahead of time into C++ by the ShiftGlue SDK and compiled for x86-64. Its GPU commands run on ShiftGlue's native Vulkan renderer, written for Pinyon Shift ( Forza Horizon ) and extended here for FM4.
Temporal upscalers now work with FM4. Render at 720p and get a sharp 1440p or 4K picture, or use them as anti-aliasing at your screen's resolution. The Xbox 360 game never computed motion, so this port rebuilds the camera, jitter and every moving car, wheel, driver and shadow from the game's draws. Choose UPSCALER on the GRAPHICS page ( BACK + START on a controller, or F6 ). How it works and what to pick: Upscalers . Everything else in this version: release notes .
Experimental release. The offline game modes play without known blocking problems (see Tested ). This repository contains no game code or assets: you need your own legally obtained copy of the game (see Legal ).
YouTube plays video at up to 60 fps; the frame rates are the game's during the recording.
Download FM4StaticRecomp-Launcher.zip from the latest release and extract it into a short folder you own, for example D:\FM4 .
Start FM4StaticRecompLauncher.exe and follow its five setup steps: Disc 1, Disc 2 (optional), the Microsoft licence, the build and your profile.
The first start compiles the game's shaders for your GPU before the title screen: about 30 seconds, longer on a processor with fewer threads. The game may look frozen meanwhile; let it finish. Later starts take a second or two; the compile runs again after an update and after a GPU driver update.
The first setup takes about 10 minutes (under 8 on the test bench ). Details: Launcher guide . Prefer the command line? See the manual install .
Compared with the original console, and with the same translation built against the stock ShiftGlue SDK (without this project's game hooks and renderer changes):
More than twice Xenia's frame rate at every scale on the same PC ( benchmarks ).
Both Disc 1 releases carry the same code; only their executables' headers differ. Any other version of default.xex will not work, because the translation is made for this exact code. Other releases are untested. config/supported-discs.json lists every Disc 1 file with its size and hash.
The 1.1 re-release (Rev 1) of Disc 1 is not supported (media ID 42C67824 ); its Disc 2 works.
Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or newer, 64-bit.
An XInput gamepad (an Xbox controller, or another pad through a mapper), or the keyboard.
Your own Forza Motorsport 4 Disc 1, as an ISO or a Games on Demand (GOD) copy. Disc 2 and DLC are optional.
An internet connection for the first setup. No administrator permission and no Visual Studio: setup downloads the parts of Microsoft's C++ runtime and Windows SDK the build needs (about 300 MB) once you accept their licences.
About 10 GB of disk space (Disc 1 7.7 GB, the build tools with Microsoft's files 1.4 GB, the source with the prebuilt SDK and the build 1 GB), plus about 5 GB for Disc 2 and DLC.
About 10 minutes for the first setup (under 0.5 GB to download, most of it from Microsoft); a rebuild after an update takes a few minutes.
Known problems are tracked as open issues . Found a new one? See Reporting issues .
Upscaler polish : the remaining shimmer (see Known limitations ).
Racing wheels , starting with MOZA wheels.
Linux : a native build of the game and the launcher.
Other disc releases , such as the Essentials Edition.
More tests on niche or legacy hardware.
Pinyon Shift by arcanite24: the Forza Horizon recompilation whose native renderer, host UI and build scripts this project builds on (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md ).
ShiftGlue SDK , Pinyon Shift's fork of the ReXGlue SDK : the recompiler and runtime. This project uses a fork of it (branch fm4-static-recomp ) with FM4's renderer fixes.
Xenia , from which much of the runtime and GPU emulation in ReXGlue derives.
fm4-recomp , an earlier FM4 recompilation on ReXGlue, which inspired this project.
AI use: code, scripts, documentation and reverse engineering of the game binary are AI-assisted.
